_help: Replace the 'override' value for each spell with the words you want to say in your language. Empty override = use the English default. Vosk only recognises words from the loaded model's lexicon — to use non-English phrases, install a same-language Vosk model from alphacephei.com/vosk/models and point voicespells-client.toml's modelPath at it. New spells installed later are appended automatically; your existing overrides are preserved.
